exercises.title: D.6. PRACTICE 1 — Choose the correct word

items.prompt: The chart shows the hobbies of ( … ).
items.explanation: “year-old” đứng trước danh từ thì không có “s”: 10-year-old children.

items.prompt: The number of ( … ) aged under 14 was 100.
items.explanation: Dưới 14 tuổi không phải “men” (đàn ông trưởng thành) → males dùng được cho mọi lứa tuổi.

items.prompt: ( … ) aged 25 to 40 spent the most on housing.
items.explanation: 25–40 tuổi là người trưởng thành → men and women.

items.prompt: The figure for ( … ) was the highest of the four countries.
items.explanation: Tên nước dạng viết tắt / có “States, Kingdom” cần “the”: the USA, the UK.

items.prompt: It is a class of ( … ).
items.explanation: “year-olds” là danh từ số nhiều khi đứng một mình: a class of 12-year-olds.

items.prompt: The proportion of ( … ) rose sharply after 2010.
items.explanation: “the + adj” chỉ một nhóm người: the elderly, the young.

exercises.title: D.7. PRACTICE 2 — Paraphrase the subject
exercises.instruction: Rewrite each phrase in two different ways (separate them with “/”).

items.prompt: children aged 5 to 11
sampleAnswers: 5- to 11-year-olds / children (who are) aged 5 to 11
items.explanation: Cách 1: tính từ ghép "5- to 11-year-olds" (year không có s khi làm tính từ). Cách 2: giữ "children" + "aged 5 to 11".

items.prompt: people aged 65 and over
sampleAnswers: the elderly / senior citizens
items.explanation: "the elderly" (the + tính từ = cả nhóm người) hoặc "senior citizens" — đều chỉ người từ 65 tuổi trở lên.

items.prompt: people from Spain
sampleAnswers: the Spanish / Spanish people
items.explanation: Người của một nước: "the + tính từ quốc tịch" (the Spanish) hoặc "tính từ + people" (Spanish people).

items.prompt: teenagers
sampleAnswers: adolescents / young people aged 13–19
items.explanation: "adolescents" là từ học thuật cho tuổi teen; hoặc diễn giải bằng độ tuổi "young people aged 13–19".

items.prompt: adults in employment
sampleAnswers: working adults / employed people
items.explanation: "in employment" = đang đi làm → "working adults" hoặc "employed people".

items.prompt: people in their forties
sampleAnswers: 40- to 49-year-olds / people aged 40 to 49
items.explanation: "in their forties" = 40–49 tuổi → "40- to 49-year-olds" hoặc "people aged 40 to 49".

exercises.title: D.8. HOMEWORK — Part 1
exercises.instruction: Write 6 English sentences comparing data between any two countries and two age groups. Each sentence must refer to the subject in a different way — no repetition.

checklist: 6 câu, mỗi câu một cách gọi chủ thể khác nhau
Có so sánh giữa hai quốc gia / hai nhóm tuổi
rubric.sampleAnswer:
1. The proportion of Japanese people aged 65 and over was higher than the figure for the USA.
2. In Canada, senior citizens outnumbered children aged 5 to 11.
3. Twelve-year-olds in Spain spent more time online than their Italian counterparts.
4. The number of males aged under 14 in Mexico was twice as high as that in Germany.
5. Adolescents in the UK used social media more than the elderly did.
6. The figure for Australians in their forties was slightly lower than that for working-age Canadians.

exercises.title: D.18. PRACTICE 1 — Rewrite without repeating words
exercises.instruction: Rewrite each sentence in a different way, keeping the same meaning.

items.prompt: The percentage of Internet users in Japan was 60%.
sampleAnswers: 60% of people in Japan used the Internet.
items.explanation: Đổi "The percentage of… was 60%" thành câu có động từ thật: "60% of people… used…".

items.prompt: The unemployment rate in Spain rose to 20%.
sampleAnswers: The level of joblessness in Spain rose to 20%.
items.explanation: "unemployment rate" ↔ "level of joblessness" — paraphrase danh từ, giữ nguyên động từ "rose to".

items.prompt: The poverty rate in Laos was 15%.
sampleAnswers: 15% of people in Laos lived below the poverty line.
items.explanation: "poverty rate" được diễn giải thành "lived below the poverty line" (sống dưới mức nghèo).

items.prompt: Sales of coffee reached $4 billion.
sampleAnswers: Coffee earned $4 billion.
Turnover from coffee reached $4 billion.
items.explanation: "Sales of coffee reached" ↔ "Coffee earned" — đổi chủ ngữ thành sản phẩm và dùng động từ earn.

items.prompt: People in Sweden spent $750 on mobile phones.
sampleAnswers: Swedish consumers spent $750 on mobile phones.
Expenditure on mobile phones in Sweden was $
items.explanation: "People in Sweden" ↔ "Swedish consumers" — dùng tính từ quốc tịch + danh từ chỉ nhóm người.

items.prompt: The number of people who travel by car doubled.
sampleAnswers: The number of car commuters doubled.
items.explanation: Mệnh đề "people who travel by car" được rút gọn thành danh từ "car commuters".

items.prompt: Beef consumption was 90 pounds per person.
sampleAnswers: The per capita consumption of beef was 90 pounds.
items.explanation: "per person" ↔ "per capita"; đưa "beef" ra sau thành "consumption of beef".

items.prompt: The amount of paper produced fell sharply.
sampleAnswers: Paper production fell sharply.
items.explanation: "The amount of paper produced" được danh hoá gọn thành "Paper production".

exercises.title: D.19. PRACTICE 2 — Three ways to report one figure
exercises.instruction: For each figure, write three different English sentences that express the same idea (write all three in that figure’s box).

stimulus.caption: Ba số liệu
rows: Average weekly spending on food in France: $120

checklist: 3 câu dùng 3 cách gọi chủ thể / 3 cấu trúc khác nhau
rubric.sampleAnswer:
1. The percentage of Internet users in Vietnam was 70%, compared to 55% in Thailand.
70% of Vietnamese people used the Internet, while the figure for Thailand was 55%.
Internet usage in Vietnam stood at 70%, 15 percentage points higher than that in Thailand.

2. The unemployment rate in the UK was 8%, twice as high as that in Mexico, at 4%.
8% of British people were jobless, compared with only 4% in Mexico.
The level of joblessness in the UK was double the figure for Mexico.

3. Average weekly spending on food in France was $120.
On average, French people spent $120 on food per week.
Weekly expenditure on food per person in France stood at $120.
commonErrors: ba câu chỉ khác một từ

exercises.title: D.20. HOMEWORK — Part 2
exercises.instruction: Choose any 5 items from Part 2 (D.9–D.17). For each item, write two English sentences using two different paraphrasing methods (one item per box, with the item name at the start).

checklist: Mỗi mục 2 câu với 2 cách paraphrase
rubric.sampleAnswer:
Gợi ý của sách (ví dụ một cặp):
D.11 — The unemployment rate in Spain was 20%.
The level of joblessness in Spain stood at 20%.
D.12 — The poverty rate in Laos was 15%.
15% of the Laotian population lived below the poverty line.
commonErrors: hai câu chỉ đổi số liệu

exercises.title: PART A1 — Multiple choice (10 points)
exercises.instruction: Choose the correct answer. 1 point each.

items.prompt: Cách viết đúng:
items.explanation: “year-old” trước danh từ: không có s, có gạch nối.

items.prompt: Từ nào KHÔNG dùng cho trẻ em?
items.explanation: women = phụ nữ trưởng thành.

items.prompt: "Người cao tuổi" là:
items.explanation: senior citizens = the elderly.

items.prompt: Chọn câu đúng:
items.explanation: “the figure for” + the USA.

items.prompt: "Per capita" đồng nghĩa với:
items.explanation: per capita = per person = bình quân đầu người.

items.prompt: "Sales" có thể thay bằng:
items.explanation: sales = turnover (doanh số).

items.prompt: "Level of joblessness" nghĩa là:
items.explanation: joblessness = unemployment.

items.prompt: Người dân Tây Ban Nha gọi là:
items.explanation: the Spanish / Spanish people.

items.prompt: "Annual" đồng nghĩa với:
items.explanation: annual = yearly = per year.

items.prompt: Câu nào đúng?
items.explanation: students đếm được → the number of.

exercises.title: PART A2 — Fill in the blanks (10 points)
exercises.instruction: Fill in: per capita / turnover / senior citizens / expenditure / commuters / joblessness / adolescents / poverty line / the aging population / males. 1 point each.

items.prompt: The number of ____ aged under 14 was 100.
items.explanation: "aged under 14" cần một danh từ chỉ người → "males" (nam giới).

items.prompt: ____ from fast food increased over the period shown.
items.explanation: "Turnover from…" = doanh thu từ một mặt hàng.

items.prompt: The ____ consumption of beef rose to 90 pounds.
items.explanation: "per capita consumption" = mức tiêu thụ bình quân đầu người, đứng trước danh từ như một tính từ.

items.prompt: Around 5 million ____ traveled by bus in 2010.
items.explanation: "traveled by bus" → người đi lại hằng ngày = "commuters".

items.prompt: The level of ____ in England fell to only 10%.
items.explanation: "The level of joblessness" = tỷ lệ thất nghiệp.

items.prompt: ____ on mobile phones rose to around $750.
items.explanation: "Expenditure on + N" = chi tiêu cho một thứ gì đó.

items.prompt: The percentage of people who live under the ____ was 10%.
items.explanation: "live under the poverty line" = sống dưới mức nghèo.

items.prompt: ____ is growing rapidly in many developed countries.
items.explanation: "is growing rapidly in developed countries" → hiện tượng dân số già hoá = "the aging population".

items.prompt: ____ aged 13 to 19 spent the most time online.
items.explanation: "aged 13 to 19" = tuổi teen → "Adolescents".

items.prompt: The proportion of ____ over 65 doubled in twenty years.
items.explanation: "over 65" → người cao tuổi = "senior citizens".

exercises.title: PART A3 — Rewrite the sentences (30 points)
exercises.instruction: Rewrite each sentence in a different way, keeping the same meaning. 3 points each.

items.prompt: The percentage of people using the Internet in Korea was 80%.
sampleAnswers: 80% of Koreans used the Internet.
items.explanation: Đổi chủ ngữ "The percentage of…" thành "80% of Koreans" + động từ thật "used".

items.prompt: The unemployment rate in Greece was 25%.
sampleAnswers: The level of joblessness in Greece was 25%.
items.explanation: "unemployment rate" ↔ "level of joblessness".

items.prompt: 12% of Indian people were poor.
sampleAnswers: The poverty rate in India was 12%.
items.explanation: Ngược chiều: "12% of Indian people were poor" → danh từ "The poverty rate in India was 12%".

items.prompt: Sales of electric cars reached $3 billion.
sampleAnswers: Turnover from electric cars reached $3 billion.
items.explanation: "Sales of…" ↔ "Turnover from…" (doanh thu).

items.prompt: People in Japan spent $500 a year on books.
sampleAnswers: Japanese consumers spent $500 per year on books.
items.explanation: "People in Japan" ↔ "Japanese consumers"; "a year" ↔ "per year".

items.prompt: The number of people who cycle to work rose.
sampleAnswers: The number of cycling commuters rose.
items.explanation: Mệnh đề "people who cycle to work" → danh từ ghép "cycling commuters".

items.prompt: Rice consumption was 100 kilograms per person per year.
sampleAnswers: Annual rice consumption per capita was 100 kilograms.
items.explanation: "per person per year" ↔ "annual … per capita".

items.prompt: Children aged 10 to 12 preferred reading.
sampleAnswers: 10- to 12-year-olds preferred reading.
items.explanation: "Children aged 10 to 12" ↔ tính từ ghép "10- to 12-year-olds".

items.prompt: The figure for people from Ireland was the lowest.
sampleAnswers: The figure for the Irish was the lowest.
items.explanation: "people from Ireland" ↔ "the Irish" (the + tính từ quốc tịch).

items.prompt: The amount of steel produced in China increased.
sampleAnswers: Steel production in China increased.
items.explanation: "The amount of steel produced" được danh hoá thành "Steel production".

exercises.title: PART B — Task 1 (choose one of the two tasks)
exercises.instruction: The table below shows the unemployment rate among people aged 16–24 and the poverty rate in four countries in 2010 and 2020 (hypothetical data). Write at least 150 words in 20 minutes. Goal: refer to the subjects in at least 4 different ways.

stimulus.caption: Unemployment (16–24) and poverty rate in four countries, 2010 and 2020 (hypothetical data)
stimulus.note: Chỉ cần làm MỘT trong hai đề của Phần B.

checklist: Gọi tên chủ thể bằng ít nhất 4 cách khác nhau
Có so sánh giữa các nước và giữa hai năm
rubric.sampleAnswer:
The table compares four countries in terms of the proportion of 16- to 24-year-olds who were out of work and the percentage of people living in poverty in 2010 and 2020.

Overall, while youth unemployment was by far the highest in Spain, Mexico had the largest share of people living below the poverty line. It is also clear that both rates fell in most of the four countries over the decade.

Spain had the highest level of joblessness among young people, at 41% in 2010, before a slight fall to 38% ten years later. The figure for England was much lower, at 18%, and it dropped to 12% in 2020. By contrast, youth unemployment in Mexico and Vietnam stood at under 10% in both years, although the Vietnamese rate rose slightly from 6% to 7%.

Turning to poverty, 46% of Mexicans were poor in 2010, which was more than twice as high as the figure for Spain, at 21%. Both countries saw only small decreases, to 41% and 20%, respectively. The poverty rate in England fell slightly from 15% to 13%, whereas Vietnam saw the most dramatic improvement, with the proportion of poor people dropping from 14% to just 5%.
commonErrors: lặp “the unemployment rate” ở mọi câu

exercises.title: PART B — Task 2 (choose one of the two tasks)
exercises.instruction: The table below shows average yearly spending per person on three items in four countries in 2015 (hypothetical data, US dollars). Write at least 150 words in 20 minutes. Goal: refer to the subjects in at least 4 different ways.

stimulus.caption: Average yearly spending per person on three items, 2015 (hypothetical data, US dollars)
stimulus.note: Chỉ cần làm MỘT trong hai đề của Phần B.

checklist: Gọi tên chủ thể bằng ít nhất 4 cách khác nhau
So sánh theo hàng và theo cột
rubric.sampleAnswer:
The table compares how much money people in Sweden, Japan, Canada and Italy spent on average each year on mobile phones, books and public transport in 2015.

Overall, Japanese people spent the most on books and public transport, while Swedes spent the most on mobile phones. Italians had the lowest spending in all three categories.

Sweden had the highest annual expenditure on mobile phones, at $750 per person, followed by Canada and Japan, at $610 and $520, respectively. Italians spent only $430. Spending on books was much lower in most countries, at $260 in Canada, $210 in Sweden and $180 in Italy. Japan, however, was an exception, with $500 per person spent on books.

Public transport accounted for the largest expenditure in Japan, at $980, which was more than twice the figure for Canada ($410). Swedes spent $640 on public transport, while Italians spent the least, at $360.
commonErrors: dùng từ xu hướng cho bảng một năm
